tool_input.command: ls data/ && head -5 data/training_data.csv && wc -l data/training_data.csv

tool_input.args: Check for feature leakage in training_data.csv with features f1-f6 and binary label. Identify which single feature leaks the outcome.

tool_input.command:
hops fg create leakage_detection_fg \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --features "row_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double,f6:double,label:int" \
  --description "Leakage detection dataset" \
  --json 2>&1
tool_input.description: Create feature group for training data
Insert training data into feature group
Delete the feature group to recreate with correct types

tool_input.command:
hops fg create leakage_detection_fg \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --features "row_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double,f6:double,label:bigint" \
  --description "Leakage detection dataset" \
  --json 2>&1
tool_input.description: Recreate feature group with bigint label
Insert training data into feature group
List tables with SSL verification disabled
Preview feature group to confirm data is there
List tables in feature store schema

tool_input.command:
hops sql --no-verify --schema mlpab34b266_featurestore --json "
SELECT 
  corr(f1, CAST(label AS double)) AS corr_f1,
  corr(f2, CAST(label AS double)) AS corr_f2,
  corr(f3, CAST(label AS double)) AS corr_f3,
  corr(f4, CAST(label AS double)) AS corr_f4,
  corr(f5, CAST(label AS double)) AS corr_f5,
  corr(f6, CAST(label AS double)) AS corr_f6
FROM leakage_detection_fg_1
" 2>&1
tool_input.description: Compute Pearson correlation between each feature and label
